concerns.text: T004 (environment & recruitment validation, incl. HF token and API ping) is placed AFTER T002 (LLM generation via HF Inference API) and T003, while plan.md orders Phase 2 (environment validation) before Phase 3 (comment generation). T002 depends on a valid HF token that T004 is supposed to confirm. Spec FR-006 only requires validation before the user study (T006), so this is not a hard violation, but the tasks document contradicts the plan's stated phase order — either move T004 before T002 or note the deliberate deviation.

T005 (smoke run) executes 'the analysis stub of T008' although T008 is defined later in Phase 2. A smoke task referencing a not-yet-specified downstream task creates a forward dependency in the task list; either define the stub inline in T005 or move the smoke checkpoint after T008's implementation is at least specified.
